# Northern California Biostatistics

> Academic research and teaching hub led by Dr. Robin Donatello, focusing on applied statistics, data science, and biostatistics with emphasis on public health, student success, and educational assessment.

Dr. Robin Donatello is a Statistics and Data Science professor at California State University, Chico, directing research projects in public health, education, and data science while maintaining an active teaching and mentoring program. The site showcases her research portfolio, publications, presentations, and collaborative projects spanning adolescent health, institutional learning assessment, and innovative automation solutions.

## About & Team

- [Dr. D. Homepage](https://www.norcalbiostat.com): Homepage for Robin Donatello, Statistics and Data Science professor at CSU Chico
- [People & Students](https://www.norcalbiostat.com/students): Team members and students working with Dr. D. on research projects

## Research Projects

- [Adolescent and School Health (ASH)](https://www.norcalbiostat.com/project/ash): LA-based teen pregnancy prevention research with LAUSD schools
- [Institutional Learning through Empirical Assessment and Researching iNterventions (iLEARN)](https://www.norcalbiostat.com/project/ilearn): iLEARN project assessing student success interventions systematically
- [Deep Learning & Automated Data Entry](https://www.norcalbiostat.com/project/cnn): CNN-based automated data entry system for PDF survey forms
- [Missing Data Methods](https://www.norcalbiostat.com/project/missing-data): Research on missing data methods across multiple project contexts
- [Community Coding](https://www.norcalbiostat.com/project/community-coding): Drop-in collaborative coding environment for CSU Chico community
- [Data Science & Politics (DS POLS) Twitter Project](https://www.norcalbiostat.com/project/ds-pols): Data science project analyzing Twitter data for political science
- [College of Natural Sciences Poster Session Automation](https://www.norcalbiostat.com/project/nsc-poster): Automated abstract submission pipeline using R, Shiny, and GitHub
- [Research Interests](https://www.norcalbiostat.com/project/blank): Research interests spanning public health, data science, and education

## Publications & Research

- [Practical Multivariate Statistics (6th Edition)](https://www.norcalbiostat.com/publication/pma6): Textbook on multivariate analysis by Afifi, May, Donatello, and Clark
- [Housing Insecurity and Student Success](https://www.norcalbiostat.com/publication/housing): Published research on housing insecurity and college student outcomes
- [Avian Influenza in California Waterfowl](https://www.norcalbiostat.com/publication/aiv): Published research on avian influenza prevalence in wild waterfowl of the Sacramento Valley
- [BLS Simulation Training for Nursing Students](https://www.norcalbiostat.com/publication/nursing_evaluation): Published research on deliberate practice in simulation and repetitive code training effectiveness

## Presentations & Talks

- [All Presentations](https://www.norcalbiostat.com/talk): Index of presentations and talks on statistics and data science
- [Reducing Costs and Risk in Large-Scale Survey Data Collection](https://www.norcalbiostat.com/talk/2023_csp): Conference talk on R automation for survey data collection cost reduction and error prevention
- [Passion-Driven Statistics During Pandemic Online Learning](https://www.norcalbiostat.com/talk/2022_csu-jmm): Analysis of Passion Driven Statistics curriculum resilience during pandemic transition
- [Make Your Own Professional Website Without HTML](https://www.norcalbiostat.com/talk/2020_ichps): Workshop on knitr for reproducible reports and professional documentation

## Educational Resources

- [Data & Datasets](https://www.norcalbiostat.com/data): Educational resources and datasets including AddHealth longitudinal study data for teaching and research
